completed_steps: 1. Read and internalized all constitutional documents: THE_HAMMER_MASTER_PROMPT.md, AGENTS.md, GEMINI.md, core.md, frontend.md.
2. Surveyed project repository for implantology, surgical protocols, extraction, bone grafting, and periodontology components.

3. Deep audit & inquisition of Implant Passport & Protocol: verified Straumann, Osstem, Nobel Biocare, Dentium, MIS, Astra Tech, Ankylos, MegaGen; torque, ISQ, healing abutments (FDM) vs cover screw, dynamic brand extensibility (Mandate 8z).

4. Deep audit & modular cockpit engineering of Bone Grafting & GBR: created VisitSurgerySinusGbrBar.tsx (201 lines) with 1-click GBR norm, bone graft chips (Bio-Oss, Cerabone, SureOss, Autograft), barrier membranes (Bio-Gide, Jason, Cytoplast d-PTFE), and titanium pins toggle.

5. Deep audit & modular cockpit engineering of Tooth Extraction protocols: created VisitSurgeryExtractionBar.tsx (221 lines) with 1-click uncomplicated norm, complexity switcher (simple, complex with Lindemann bur, impacted/dystopic), hemostasis chips (Alvogyl, collagen sponge, Vicryl 4-0, tampon 20 min), and 1-click patient WhatsApp/Telegram memo copy.
6. Created VisitSurgeryImplantBar.tsx (239 lines) with 8 global implant brands, custom brand support, torque/ISQ stability presets, cap and suture options.

7. Refactored VisitSurgeryProtocolTab.tsx down to 578 lines: dynamic category-driven cockpit router rendering extraction, sinus/GBR, or implant bar based on active surgical norm; enhanced 1-click norm population.

8. Deep audit of Periodontal Examination: verified Florida probe 6-point probing (192 sites), CAL = PD + GR invariants, Hamp furcation, Miller mobility I..III, BOP % & plaque indices, PSR screening, 1-click healthy periodontium norm.

9. Bird-language purge (Mandates 8y/8x/8z): eradicated Soviet bureaucratic ciphers ('Форма 043/у', '043-у') from visible UI buttons, toasts, and headers in ImplantPassportModal, ImplantPassportCard, and ImplantDiaryTab, replacing them with clean clinical Russian ('В дневник приёма', 'Медицинская карта пациента').
10. Extended test suite: added 4 new comprehensive test cases in surgeryCockpitModal.test.tsx and updated implantPassport.test.tsx with zero-bird-language assertions.

11. Machine verification gates passed: 88 targeted domain unit tests 100% green across 19 suites, check:encoding clean on 7334 files, check-css-tokens clean on 165 CSS files, all files strictly <= 800 lines.

findings.summary: VisitSurgeryProtocolTab previously only rendered a static 4-brand implant toolbar regardless of whether the doctor performed an extraction, sinus lift, or implantation. Decomposed and created dedicated modular cockpits (VisitSurgeryExtractionBar, VisitSurgerySinusGbrBar, VisitSurgeryImplantBar) that dynamically activate based on the surgical norm.

ImplantPassportModal, ImplantPassportCard, and ImplantDiaryTab contained visible bureaucratic tokens like 'Карта 043/у' and 'Форма 043/у Минздрав РФ'. Replaced with clinical Russian 'В дневник приёма' and 'Медицинская карта пациента'.

1-click uncomplicated norms verified for extraction ('✓ Протокол без осложнений: лунка ушита, гемостаз полный'), GBR ('✓ Норма НКР: дефект заполнен остеопластиком, мембрана фиксирована пинами, швы глухие'), and implantation ('✓ Норма имплантации: 35 Н·см, ISQ 72, ФДМ/заглушка'). Soft warehouse overdraft active across all workflows.

Florida probe 192 measurement points (MV, V, DV, ML, L, DL for 32 teeth), CAL = PD + GR formulas (including positive recession and negative pseudopockets), Hamp furcation I..IV, and Miller mobility I..III confirmed mathematically sound and covered by 43 unit tests.
